trap.label: phrasal verb
trap.wrong: She took a new client on.
trap.right: She took on a new client.
trap.why: Em português não há partícula. O brasileiro às vezes usa take sozinho (“tomou um cliente”). Take on = assumir; take over = assumir o controle.

opts: She took the job on of.

fix.wrong: She took in a new client. (assumiu)
fix.right: She took on a new client.

fix.wrong: He took the company over it.

fix.right: I took up a new hobby.

rewrite.prompt: Use take on: “She accepted a new client.”
rewrite.answer: She took on a new client.

rewrite.prompt: Use take over: “He assumed control of the firm.”
